description: This Java source file defines the AcknowledgementsJsonParser class, which is responsible for parsing Acknowledgements objects from JSON representations. It implements the Function interface and provides methods to parse JSON data into domain-specific objects while handling error cases related to JSON structure and content. The parser also validates certain fields like entity type and status code, and interacts with related parsers and data structures such as Acknowledgement, EntityIdWithType, and JsonObject.

classes.name: AcknowledgementsJsonParser
classes.description: A final class implementing a JSON parser for Acknowledgements objects, parameterized with an EntityIdWithType subtype, utilizing an AcknowledgementJsonParser to parse individual acknowledgements from JSON objects.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of AcknowledgementsJsonParser with a provided AcknowledgementJsonParser.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Overrides the Function interface method to parse a JsonObject into an Acknowledgements instance.

methods.name: tryToParseJsonObject
methods.description: Attempts to parse a JsonObject into an Acknowledgements instance, catching and translating various exceptions into JsonParseException.

methods.name: parseJsonObject
methods.description: Parses the JsonObject to extract entity ID, entity type, acknowledgements list, and headers, constructing an Acknowledgements object and validating fields.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Extracts and parses the entity ID from the JsonObject using the provided acknowledgementJsonParser.

methods.name: getAcknowledgements
methods.description: Retrieves and parses the acknowledgements list from the JsonObject, filtering out JSON schema version fields.

methods.name: parseAcknowledgement
methods.description: Processes each JsonField representing acknowledgements, handling both array and single object JSON values.

methods.name: parseAcknowledgementFromObject
methods.description: Converts a JsonValue into an Acknowledgement instance, validating the JSON structure and entity ID.

methods.name: validateEntityId
methods.description: Checks that the entity ID in the acknowledgement matches the expected entity ID, throwing an exception if not.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Extracts and constructs DittoHeaders from the JsonObject.

methods.name: validateEntityType
methods.description: Validates that the entity type from JSON matches an expected value.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Retrieves the status code from JSON and converts it to an HttpStatusCode object.

methods.name: validateStatusCode
methods.description: Ensures the status code from JSON matches the expected status code.
